title: Filenode spec: update JMAP-QUOTAS reference to RFC9425 (now published)
description:
draft-atwood-jmap-chat-filenode-00.md still references {{JMAP-QUOTAS}} as a draft (lines 46 and 107). JMAP Quotas is now published as RFC 9425. Core draft was updated to use the bare RFC9425 reference under jmap-chat-spec-m6n.1; filenode should follow the same pattern for consistency.

Changes:
1. Replace the JMAP-QUOTAS entry in the informative references block (line ~46) with a bare 'RFC9425:' entry, placed numerically among other bare RFC references.
2. Replace the body citation '{{JMAP-QUOTAS}}' on line ~107 with '{{RFC9425}}'.
3. Grep the filenode draft afterward to confirm zero remaining JMAP-QUOTAS references.

Out of scope for m6n.1 (which was scoped to core spec only); filed separately to avoid 'while I'm here' creep.
acceptance_criteria: grep -n 'JMAP-QUOTAS' draft-atwood-jmap-chat-filenode-00.md returns zero matches. RFC9425 appears in the informative reference block and in the body where the JMAP Quota extension is cited.
